result.description: Lumea Canvas is a fictional high-capacity desktop memory kit designed for creative workstations and general productivity systems. It uses standard DDR4 UDIMM form factor, runs at 3200 MT/s, and provides a total of 24GB across a matched 2x12GB configuration for balanced multitasking performance. The module set is intended for mainstream Intel and AMD desktop platforms with support for XMP-style profile tuning, low-profile heat spreaders, and a modest 1.35V operating voltage.
result.title: Lumea Canvas 24GB DDR4 Desktop Memory Kit
